text:
sam: FYI scheduled deploy 00:30 UTC tonight — quiet window 15m. Plan: enable feature flag `search-mlv2` with a soft ramp (0% -> 25% -> 50% over 15m). Pin cohort `beta-eu` for 1h. Requesting +1 from eng-releases.

olivia: +1. Telemetry hooks are wired (latency/p50/p95, 5xx rate, request rate). Fallback route -> model-v1 is ready.

ben: Please add an automatic drain policy: if 5xx > 1% OR p95 > 400ms for 5m then auto-drain and rollback. Also request a manual pause at the 25% step.

sam: Ack. Patch for rollout config below.
```
flag: search-mlv2
ramp: [0,25,50]
step_delay: 7m30s
pin: beta-eu
auto_drain: {"5xx_pct": 1.0, "p95_ms": 400, "window": "5m"}
```

deploy-bot: [1735557820] starting rollout: canary id canary-2023-09-01-17. command: `./rdeploy --ff search-mlv2 --ramp 0,25,50 --pin beta-eu`

deploy-bot: canary-2023-09-01-17 status: HEALTHY -> p95=370ms, 5xx=0.18%, progressing to 25% step.

maya: seeing a few 503s from EU-2 (host eu-2a). Small spike but not yet > drain thresh. Recommend hold at 25% for another 5m to confirm.

olivia: pausing ramp. manual hold at 25% requested by @olivia.
deploy-bot: ramp paused at 25% (operator: olivia).

deploy-bot: live logs during hold: 5xx rising from 0.18% -> 1.9% over 6m, p95 -> 420ms (EU-2 subset).

ben: that's above our drain thresholds. Recommend immediate rollback and unpin cohort.
sam: agree. initiating rollback now. Run command: `./rdeploy rollback --canary canary-2023-09-01-17 --ff search-mlv2 --to model-v1 --unpin beta-eu`

deploy-bot: rollback started. disabling flag `search-mlv2`, routing traffic back to model-v1, unpinning beta-eu.

deploy-bot: rollback complete at 00:49 UTC. Metrics back to baseline: p95=350ms, 5xx=0.12%. Canary canary-2023-09-01-17 terminated.

oncall-bot: incident created (INC-20230901-42) because 5xx > 1% during ramp; status: resolved.

maya: capturing logs and sample traces for EU-2. Will attach to the incident.

sam: thanks. Follow-up action: create a short postmortem and schedule a bisect during next dev window. Tagging @platform to validate kernel selection & quantization flags for EU region.

olivia: +1. I'll hold the rollout until kernel/infra check is complete.

ben: noted — also consider reducing step size (0->10->25->50) next attempt and enable verbose KV-cache logging for the canary.

sam: creating a doc and adding action items. Closing thread for now.
